description: Accessibility per boarding edge, keyed by edge SLOID (join with edges.geojson). atlas_platform = atlas platform-v2 row, field names in snake_case, enumerations as published, lengths and heights in centimetres as in atlas. bfr_wheelchair = BfR_Haltestellendaten flags as published. Each row gives the wheelchair boarding class for the period valid_from..valid_to: Autonomie (independent boarding), Rampeneinsatz (ramp operated by staff), Voranmeldung (advance notice needed), Ersatztransport (replacement shuttle), keinZugang (no access), keineInfo (no information). The prefixes sg / ug are the publisher's column prefixes; in the data they line up with track-bound vehicles (train, tram) and vehicles that are not track-bound (bus). That reading is ours and is not stated on the dataset page.
